provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: projection monotonicity applied to the exact rank-5 exclusion at m=5

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop (shared, load 70), three census runs of 25 s each at m = 4 and 5

llm.role: found the forced-subspace reduction, wrote the census and the certificate

notes: (<0| (x) I)|sqrtT>^6 = 2^{-1/2} |sqrtT>^5 and a computational-basis slice of a stabilizer state is a stabilizer state or zero, so chi(|sqrtT>^6) >= chi(|sqrtT>^5) = 6 (qubit_sqrtT-m5-lower-6.json, exact). First lower bound for this cell; with the product upper bound 12 the cell is 6 <= chi <= 12, and chi <= 7 here would beat the published exponent 1/2 (log_2(7)/6 = 0.4680). The six product states phi^6 span only the hyperplane f(1) = f(5) of Sym^6 and no symmetric six-qubit stabilizer state leaves it, so the symmetric construction that gives the m <= 5 witnesses stops at m = 6.
